'''Franklin Blackheart''' was the brother of [[Harrison Blackheart]] and a member of the [[Ravenwood Rebellion]]. He was killed by Greymane loyalists led by [[Captain Veller]],<ref>{{questlong|Horde|45|The Blackheart Killer}}</ref> and his entire camp was burned to the ground.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|45|Greymane Hatred}}</ref> His brother buried him in a ruin located just south of the [[Ruins of Greyshire]].

==Grave==
{{Book|Grave of Franklin Blackheart|content=
A hastily constructed grave. The following words are etched into the wood in crude handwriting.

<Franklin Blackheart. Rest easy brother.>
}}
